description: Shaped VCA is a stereo polyphonic amplifier with a variable response curve, plus ring and amplitude modulation, output offset, clipping and oversampling

params.text: Sets the range of the Level knob: 0 to 1, 0 to 2, 0 to 10, or the bipolar ranges -1 to 1, -2 to 2 and -10 to 10
Sets the VCA mode: unipolar 0-10V or 0-5V clipped CV for two quadrant work, or bipolar -10V to 10V or -5V to 5V unclipped for four quadrant ring modulation; the 5V modes double the CV
Sets the clipping on the output: off, hard clipping at 10V either way, or soft tanh clipping at 10V either way for saturation
Sets oversampling against the aliasing clipping and non-linear curves introduce: off, x4, x8, x16 or x32; ring or amplitude modulation on a logarithmic curve needs it
Adds an offset to the output before clipping: none, -5V or +5V
Sets the maximum gain applied to the inputs, over the range the R button selects; the default is unity gain in every range
Adds an offset of -5V to 5V to the Level CV input before any exponential or logarithmic shaping
Bends the response of the level CV: fully clockwise an approximated logarithm, noon linear, fully anticlockwise exponential, with intermediate settings crossfading between them

inputs.text: Voltage control of the gain, 10V for the full level set by the knob and 0V for silence, with the curve between them set by the response curve; unpatched it reads 10V
Multiplied by 10 and summed with the response curve knob, the total clamped to 100% either way; unpatched it reads 0V
The left signal to be amplified; unpatched it reads a constant 10V, so the module can work as a CV source or as a waveshaper for the Level input
The right signal to be amplified; unpatched it follows the left input

outputs.text: The left input after the gain, the output offset and any clipping
The right input after the gain, the output offset and any clipping

menu: Exp/Log algorithm — corrected is the current pair of shaping formulas, while intermediate and original reproduce older exponential and logarithm behaviour for patches built on them
Oversample filter quality — 10th order by default, with 8th order and a cheaper 6th order; 10th and 8th cut at 80% of Nyquist and 6th at 50%
